name: Its Time To Meet God
detailed_description:
1. Divine Premise & Celestial Stakes
Step into the boots of a bold pilgrim who’s dared to breach the boundaries between mortal coil and the 3rd Heaven. In Its Time To Meet God, you are thrown into interdimensional rifts conjured by demi‑gods, eldritch horrors and angelic sentinels alike. Your mission? Survive these unholy realms, unravel the mysteries woven into each plane, and ascend to the ultimate confrontation in the Peace and Tranquility of the Third Heaven.

2. Ruthless Ray casting Combat & Tactical Loot
Arm yourself with an infinite stock of razor‑sharp throwing knives before you discover the heavier firepower of shotguns, pistols, and dual‐wielded handguns. Every strike demands precision—every reload could mean life or death. 

3. Psychedelic Realms & Ever‑Shifting Replay ability
Every run catapults you into captivating procedurally generated dreamscapes drenched in mind‑bending color palettes and neon lighting effects. No two journeys look or play the same: Items don’t carry across runs, so every expedition is a fresh test of your reflexes and strategy.

short_description: Its Time To Meet God is an interdimensional ray casting shooter, built from the ground up in Game Maker Studio. Fight and loot your way through interdimensional realms created by demi Gods, eldritch horrors, and holy creatures to achieve the peace and tranquility of residing within the 3rd Heaven.
